_about: Tests that still read the playtest town. tools\cli test runs them in a second boot on DebugWorld; every other WORLD and PERSISTENCE test boots GridWorld (tools/lib/test-world.mjs, docs/architecture/three-worlds.md). Seeded from the W1 GridWorld failures (#1803) plus the town tests added since (#1804). Remove a pin when its test gains grid fixtures; the list should end empty. Slice #1808 (W7) removed 11 pins (the jail cluster and the farm plots) with the Grid_test_fixtures cell: one EL_JailCell and farm_plot_1..3. The 41 left need fixtures that are not one prefab each: shops and tills, a zone, spawn points, signs, quest givers, organization hideouts, the car lot and impound desk, and the roadmap scenarios. Each is a follow-up card; a test that is really about the town moves out of the suite instead.
